notes.title: V 1.0.1.14
notes.notes:
Fixed:

[list]
[*] Game could freeze or crash while climbing.
[*] Can't change an area after being hit when all enemies are dead.
[*] Can't change an area after returning to previously visited areas and attacking dead enemies with a bomb or shuriken.
[/list]
IMPORTANT NOTE:
An option to change controls for gamepad was added in one of the previous patches. 
So if you wish to use left stick instead of D-pad for movement, for example, it can be done in the options.

notes.title: V 1.0.1.5
notes.notes:
Fixed:

[list]
[*] Game crashing in certain areas which player visited before.
[*] Broken save before the final boss causing crash during loading. The save is fixed now and will load the game properly.
[*] Can't change location after defeating Pyro (the second boss).
[*] Screen gets very dark when the game is loaded from menu right after dying.
[/list]

notes.title: V 1.0.1.3
notes.notes:
Bugs fixed:

[list]
[*] Game could crash after using a consumable item outside inventory.
[*] After equipping a Dao Monk Robe armour, any other equipped piece of armour would reduce the chi bar. Loading a save now, will return the lost chi if you've encountered the bug.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added an option to change controls for a gamepad.
[*] Some minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Meifumado is an action game set in a post-apocalyptic world inspired by Japan
notes.notes:
Love your pixel-art side-scrolling action RPGs? Keep an eye on Meifumado, as it looks pretty good and it will be coming to Linux the developer has confirmed.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/04/meifumado-is-an-action-game-set-in-a-post-apocalyptic-world-inspired-by-japan
